messages.subject: Install new version of shinyStan
parts:
Attached is an R function that will install the newest version of shinyStan for anyone interested in trying it out.

A lot of the changes are aesthetic (the whole thing looks a lot better), but there's also a decent bit of new content, including plots of N_eff/N, se_mean/sd, and a 3D scatter plot. I've also added a glossary for each table that defines some of the less well known terms (e.g. n_divergent).
